message: September 10. Late at night.
Tonight's observations finally recorded an hourly rate of over 180 meteors.
That far exceeds the peak rates of even the most famous meteor showers.
In this town, known for its frequent shooting stars, that is not especially unusual.
Re-Crea must be approaching once again.
After twenty-five years of silence, it seems to have finally begun stirring.
No previous Re-Crea has ever followed such a long interval.
What does that span of twenty-five years mean?
The records indicate that its influence grows in proportion to the length of the interval.
And then there is the number of shooting stars.
With each passing day, it continues to rise without any sign of slowing.
We now face a development unlike anything I have witnessed, or anything described in the records.
We have been preparing ways to respond since we noticed the vicious cycle twelve years ago.
But Re-Crea is not something we can see.
We cannot even predict what, exactly, will happen.
In the past, all we have seen are people taking advantage of the confusion to disturb the peace.
Preventing further disasters. That is what we have done to preserve the world.
Surely this time will be no different.
If we deal with those threats properly, then once Re-Crea passes, life will return to normal.
Yes... if only this were an ordinary Re-Crea.
The shooting stars, my unease, and the records handed down through the generations will not let me believe that.
Perhaps...
The largest Re-Crea in recorded history is approaching.
Without a doubt.
With every passing moment.
And we have yet to find even a single clue to a solution.
"Even if I'm powerless, I'll never give up."
"What is it that gives you such determination?"
"I suppose... it's faith."
"Faith...?"
"In that dependable daredevil who appears out of nowhere during Re-Crea..."
"Ah... you still believe that story?\S10"
"Of course! After all, we have..."
"We have the Demon Lord!!"
